import numpy as np
from itertools import product
def fit(tb,pb,names):
    cols=[];nm=[]
    for (i,ft),(j,fp) in product(enumerate(tb),enumerate(pb)):
        cols.append(ft(t)*fp(P)); nm.append(names[0][i]+'*'+names[1][j])
    X=np.array(cols).T
    c,*_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dP_dt,rcond=None)
    r=dP_dt-X@c
    return np.mean(r**2)/np.var(dP_dt),c,nm
